selection_rules.method: scripts/run_cli_quality_baseline.py select (CPU-only GT scan via aimocap.data.panoptic)
notes: pose2 has no hdVideos on disk (calibration + GT only); excluded from run cases.
pose3 ships only 4 complete videos (00_03, 00_04, 00_24, 00_28); partial .part files excluded.

pose3 usable clip range is conservatively [150, 450): inside the sync_frames-verified range. Pixel comparison of video frames vs sync_frames jpgs was inconclusive (static scene), so extension beyond global 449 is NOT assumed.
pose1 turn/legs rules coincided at global 1050; the turn-flavoured case is kept on pose1 and the legs-flavoured case on pose3, so every run case has a distinct window.

ALIGNMENT CORRECTION 2026-10-04: trim videos start at global frame 0 (not 150 as previously assumed). global_start_frame values corrected to the ACTUAL det coverage of the frozen artifacts (calm 300, fast_arms 1500, turn 900, legs 0, narrow 1500). Evidence: 4-case GT-anchored alignment scan (sharp minima at -150) + 3D MPJPE 26.6mm vs 160.3mm at corrected start.
